chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"What is hunted between the two Harras is forbidden from the game of al-Madīnah."

key_terms.الْحَرَّتَيْنِ: the two rocky volcanic tracts marking the area of al-Madīnah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about hunting within the sanctuary of Madinah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal prohibition concerning hunting within the sacred boundary of al-Madīnah, specifically the area between its two volcanic tracts. It reflects the sanctity and protected status of Madinah in Shia hadith literature.
